title: Dual-Core Tensor Wheel Decomposition with Structure-Cached Acceleration for Tensor Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.13938v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tensor wheel decomposition captures complex correlations in high-dimensional data through interactions between outer-ring factors and a high-order central core. However, updating these components requires the explicit construction and manipulation of large-scale matrices, which limits computational efficiency and incurs particularly high computational and memory costs for the central-core update. To address these limitations, we propose dual-core tensor wheel decomposition (DCTW), which factorizes the central core into two lower-order cores linked by a shared latent bond. Each core is coupled to a different group of outer-ring factors. We further propose a structure-cached acceleration strategy that avoids explicit large-scale matrix multi- plications and caches intermediate tensors generated during tensor network contractions for reuse across block updates. translated_title: 具有结构缓存加速的双核张量轮分解方法用于张量恢复
translated_abstract: 张量轮分解通过外环因子与高阶中心核之间的相互作用来捕获高维数据中的复杂关联。然而，更新这些组件需要显式构造和操作大规模矩阵，这限制了计算效率，并对中心核的更新带来了尤其高昂的计算和内存开销。为解决这些局限，我们提出了双核张量轮分解（DCTW），将中心核分解为两个由共享潜变量键连接的低阶核，且每个核分别与不同的外环因子组相耦合。我们进一步提出了一种结构缓存加速策略，该策略避免了显式的大规模矩阵乘法，并将张量网络收缩过程中生成的中间张量缓存下来，以便在各块更新之间重复利用。这种重用减少了冗余计算，并避免了大规模矩阵的显式构造，从而显著提升了计算与内存效率。
tldr: 该论文提出双核张量轮分解（DCTW）及结构缓存加速策略，通过将高阶中心核分解为两个由共享潜变量键连接的低阶核，并缓存张量网络收缩中的中间张量以避免显式构造大规模矩阵和冗余计算，从而大幅提升了张量恢复的计算与内存效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes dual-core tensor wheel decomposition (DCTW) with a structure-cached acceleration strategy, which factorizes the high-order central core into two lower-order cores linked by a shared latent bond and caches intermediate tensors from tensor network contractions, avoiding explicit large-scale matrix construction and redundant computation to achieve efficient tensor recovery.
